execution.isolation: Fresh context per case; read the skill and selectively its references, not other skills or grading criteria.
execution.permissions: No network, product work, Git, secrets or delegation. Writes are allowed only for the selected concept in the save case's disposable fixture.
execution.turns: Submit messages in order; retain actual responses. Never invent user selections or validation results.

cases.fixture: Provide a new empty disposable project directory. Permit creation of docs/ideas/ and the selected idea file only.
messages: Earlier we compared a new meeting tool, written input and a follow-through pilot for our retrospective. I selected the follow-through pilot; keep meeting length unchanged and use existing notes. Eight people attend; action items reportedly go unfinished. We have not checked owner capacity or whether participation will improve. Save the idea as Retrospective Follow-Through Pilot using your default idea path. Use the confirmed direction, show assumptions and a proposed validation step; do not run the pilot or ask me again where to save.
expected: Reuse the stated exploration and selection without another gate.
Separate reported problems, unknown capacity/participation and proposed pilot checks.
prohibited: Asking again for the default path
Claiming capacity or improved participation is proven
Writing outside the authorized concept location
cases.quality: The concept is actionable, constraint-aware and preserves selection/evidence status.

messages: We already approved adult volunteers as our audience and existing email as our only channel. Help explore how to reduce missed annual safety training. Misses are rare but have high consequences. No additional evidence about why volunteers miss it is available. Return only an alternatives comparison and the questions we need to investigate; do not choose a direction, save a file, or design a full product. Compare practical approaches without treating rarity as low value or assuming the cause is forgetfulness.
expected: Offer meaningfully different approaches within audience/channel constraints and explain their bets/trade-offs.
Keep causes hypothetical and identify learning questions.
Respect comparison-only output and high-consequence low-frequency value.
prohibited: Creating a concept file or full product plan
Treating reminder automation as a proven solution
cases.quality: Alternatives address distinct possible causes without using generic novelty or frequency rankings as a verdict.

messages: I have a vague idea to help neighbors share things. I haven't decided who to focus on, what kinds of things, or what would count as success. Help me explore the idea, but do not save anything yet. Start with the questions that would shape useful alternatives, rather than assuming I need an app.
expected: Ask a manageable set of neutral questions about people, needs, situations and outcomes.
Leave mechanisms open and distinguish unknowns from facts.
prohibited: Prescribing an app before understanding the need
Saving a document or demanding a save path now
cases.quality: The questions obtain context useful for divergent exploration instead of presenting a generic questionnaire or premature solution.
